text: dsh-win-toolkit 是面向 DSH 的 Windows 原生能力插件，向 agent 注册工具并通过 PowerShell 操作本机功能。它可读取或写入剪贴板、显示完成通知、查看 hosts 文件、诊断 DNS 与 TCP 端口、列出并聚焦窗口、截取虚拟屏幕、查看进程内存占用，以及用默认应用打开文件、文件夹或网址。另附 doctor 命令检查 Windows、PowerShell、剪贴板和其他依赖条件。适合在 Windows 桌面环境中希望让 DSH 协助处理系统操作的用户；需要 Windows、PowerShell 5.1+ 和 Node.js 22+。

dsh-win-toolkit adds Windows tools to DSH through PowerShell: clipboard access, notifications, hosts inspection, DNS and TCP checks, window controls, screenshots, process lists, and opening files or URLs. Its doctor command checks prerequisites. It requires Windows, PowerShell 5.1+, and Node.js 22+.
想让 DSH 直接读取我 Windows 剪贴板里的文字。
有没有办法让 agent 把一段内容写进系统剪贴板？
长任务结束后能不能弹出 Windows 通知提醒我？
我想检查某个主机的 DNS 解析和 TCP 端口是否可连。
怎么查看 Windows hosts 文件当前有哪些内容？
让 DSH 帮我找出当前打开的窗口并切到指定窗口。
我需要让 agent 截取当前 Windows 桌面屏幕。
电脑变慢时，能否列出最占内存的进程？
Can my assistant read or update the Windows clipboard?
I want a desktop alert when a long task has finished.
Help me check DNS resolution and whether a TCP port is reachable.
Can the agent capture my Windows screen or find a window?
dsh-win-toolkit 的功能「剪贴板读写」：agent 可调用工具读取当前剪贴板文本，也可传入文本替换剪贴板内容；读取结果包含文本和是否为空，写入结果返回状态与字符数。
dsh-win-toolkit 的功能「桌面通知」：agent 传入标题和正文后显示 Windows 弹窗，约六秒后自动关闭，可用于提示长任务已经完成。
dsh-win-toolkit 的功能「网络诊断」：传入主机名或 IP 和可选 TCP 端口（默认 443），工具返回 DNS 地址解析结果与端口连接状态。
dsh-win-toolkit 的功能「桌面与进程工具」：可列出可见窗口并按标题片段聚焦窗口，截取虚拟屏幕为 PNG，也能按内存排序查看进程并用默认程序打开路径或网址。
该插件需要 Windows 和 powershell.exe；通知需 WScript.Shell COM，截图需 Windows Forms 与 Drawing。

dsh-win-toolkit README · When you need this：- You copied something and want the agent to read it directly, instead of pasting it into the chat
- A long task finishes while you are in another window and you want a desktop notification
- GitHub is unreachable and you want the agent to diagnose it rather than guess

Every value crosses the PowerShell boundary as Base64, so clipboard contents and hostnames cannot inject a command. `doctor` checks the environment before you run into a missing piece.

Gives your dsh agent real Windows superpowers — clipboard, system notifications, hosts file inspection, and network diagnostics — backed by safe, parameterized PowerShell. No extra installs, no admin rights required for the current toolset.

dsh-win-toolkit README · Check your environment first：```sh
dsh-win-toolkit doctor
```

It verifies the platform, PowerShell, execution policy, clipboard access, WScript.Shell COM and hosts readability — everything the tools rely on.

dsh-win-toolkit README · Requirements：| | |
|---|---|
| OS | **Windows 10 or 11** — the tools call `powershell.exe` |
| PowerShell | **5.1+** (the default on Windows 10/11); PowerShell 7 works as well but is not required |
| Privileges | none for the current tools — everything is read-only except clipboard write and the notification popup |
| Node | 22+ (for the plugin host) |

Run `dsh-win-toolkit doctor` to verify all of the above on your machine before blaming the plugin.

dsh-win-toolkit README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `win_clipboard_read` | Read the current clipboard text |
| `win_clipboard_write` | Write text to the clipboard |
| `win_notify` | Show a system popup notification (auto-closes) |
| `win_hosts_list` | Read the Windows hosts file |
| `win_netdiag` | DNS resolution + TCP port test for any host |
| `win_window_list` | List visible windows: title, process, PID |
| `win_window_focus` | Bring a window to the front by title substring |
| `win_screenshot` | Capture the screen to a PNG and return its path and size |
| `win_process_list` | Top processes by memory, optionally filtered by name |
| `win_open` | Open a file, folder or URL with the default application |

dsh-win-toolkit README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-win-toolkit
dsh web   # restart
```

Then just ask your agent, e.g.:
- "check if github.com:443 is reachable" → `win_netdiag`
- "put this text on my clipboard" → `win_clipboard_write`
- "notify me when you're done" → `win_notify`

dsh-win-toolkit README · How it works：Every tool runs a short PowerShell snippet through `powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive`. All user input crosses the script boundary as **Base64** — never string-interpolated — so argument injection is structurally impossible.

- Config: `psTimeoutMs` (default 20000) — per-call PowerShell timeout, settable in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under the `win-toolkit` entry.
- Windows-only: tools fail loudly with a clear error on non-Windows platforms (the entry itself is a no-op there).
dsh-win-toolkit README · Roadmap：- `win_hosts_edit` (admin-gated hosts entries), `win_env`, `win_service`, `win_window`, `win_task`, `win_netdiag` deep mode (proxy check, DNS server, traceroute).

dsh-win-toolkit README · Troubleshooting：- Tools fail with "PowerShell failed": usually an anti-virus or execution-policy quirk — the plugin uses `-NoProfile -NonInteractive` but policy still applies. Check `Get-ExecutionPolicy`; the plugin does not require RemoteSigned.
- Want to see exactly what runs? The PowerShell snippets are short and readable in `src/index.ts`.
